reasons.persona_fit: Directly targets small business owner-operators with Bareni's calm, practical tone, enforces human approval, and respects the no-CTA brief.
reasons.clarity: Structure is straightforward and logical, clearly explaining when to automate versus when to keep a workflow manual.
reasons.actionability: Provides a realistic 1-week process mapping exercise and clear decision criteria without forcing unnecessary automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Accurately references the accounts-payable demo as synthetic and self-built, explicitly clarifying that claims workflow automation is a design rule rather than an existing deployment.
